title: Encyclopedia of Needlework
author: Thérèse de Dillmont

authorInfo.bio: Thérèse de Dillmont (1846–1890) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "Encyclopedia of Needlework" by Thérèse de Dillmont is a comprehensive guide on needlework written in the late 19th century. This work serves as an extensive reference manual for all aspects of needlecraft, including both plain and fancy techniques.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Named creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.
